When large sheets of malignant cells are present, necrosis may be seen. With adequate tissue sampling, in situ carcinoma can be demonstrated in association with the infiltrating carcinoma. The in situ component is nearly always ductal but occasionally may be lobular or both.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 针对神经肌肉接头乙酰胆碱受体(AChR)、MuSK或LRP4的自身抗体破坏突触后膜传递，诱发骨骼肌易疲劳与呼吸/吞咽肌麻痹；约15%–20%全身型MG(gMG)患者可突发“肌无力危象”，在数小时至数日内因急性高碳酸性呼吸衰竭或误吸窒息危及生命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 抗胆碱酯酶药、糖皮质激素/免疫抑制剂联合胸腺切除使多数患者达到微小症状表达(MMS)；FcRn拮抗剂(艾加莫德)及C5补体抑制剂(依库珠单抗)于2023年国谈入常规药品保障后，显著提升了难治性gMG控制率与危象急救成功率。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE与GBD 2021将MG归入“其他神经系统疾病”，未公布全球单独年死亡人数；国际队列肌无力危象住院死亡率已从历史>40%降至现代ICU约2%–5%

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 无全国绝对死亡总数；中国国家死因监测系统测算MG年龄标化死亡率(ASMR)约1.86/100万，中位死亡年龄59.4岁（PMID: 37212271）；HQMS住院病死率约14.69‰（PMC8315547）
annual_deaths_china.source: China National Mortality Surveillance System (PMID: 37212271) / PMC8315547

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球平均患病率约173/百万（Orphanet全球7.77/10万，欧洲约20/10万，ORPHA:589）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国年发病率约0.68/10万（PMC8315547），推算全国全身型重症肌无力(gMG)患者约17万人；全身型重症肌无力纳入国家《第一批罕见病目录》

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 肌无力危象(Myasthenic Crisis)急危重症救治：(1) 当出现用力肺活量<15 mL/kg、呼吸窘迫或球麻痹排痰无力时立即行气管插管有创机械通气（早期轻中度呼吸窘迫可严密监护下短时试用BiPAP），同时停用或减停胆碱酯酶抑制剂以减少呼吸道分泌物并排除胆碱能危象；(2) 立即启动快速免疫急救：静脉丙种球蛋白(IVIG 0.4 g/kg/日×5天)或血浆置换(PE 5次)，可联用或桥接靶向FcRn/补体生物制剂；(3) 排查诱因（肺部感染、误停药、禁忌药物如氨基糖苷类/氟喹诺酮类/镁剂）并同步静脉足量糖皮质激素或非激素免疫抑制剂。

master.definition_en: Argyria is a rare dermatosis, which can be either localized or systemic, that occurs after prolonged contact and absorption of silver containing compounds over a period of years and that is characterized by irreversible blue-gray to gray-black staining of skin, fingernails and/or mucous membranes, most evident on sun exposed areas of the skin. Silver exposure is usually occupational but may also occur through dental amalgams, the ingestion of colloidal silver, acupuncture needles, orthopedic implants and topical medications (such as silver sulfadiazine).

master.name_en: neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia, brain anomalies, distinctive facies, and absent language
master.definition_en: A syndromic neurodevelopmental disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in RNU4-2 gene and is inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern. It is characterized by moderate to severe global developmental delay/intellectual disability, speech anomalies (mostly non-verbal), hypotonia, abnormal brain MRI (reduced white matter volume, hypoplasia of the corpus callosum, ventriculomegaly, and delayed myelination), dysmorphic facial features, short stature, microcephaly, behavioral issues, seizures and feeding difficulties, as well as variable vision, gastrointestinal, endocrine, skeletal, genitourinary, cardiac, and cutaneous anomalies. It has autosomal dominant inheritance.

master.name_en: Anomalous origin of coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
master.definition_en: A rare coronary artery congenital malformation characterized by an anomalous origin of the left (ALCAPA) or right (ARCAPA) coronary artery from the pulmonary artery, with variable clinical presentation, ranging from asymptomatic to early heart failure and death depending on the degree of development of collateral circulation between the left and right coronary artery systems, as well as the pressure level of the pulmonary artery. Infants typically present with feeding difficulties, failure to thrive, dyspnea, irritability, hyperhidrosis, heart murmurs, tachypnea, tachycardia and/or chest pain while adults usually associate dyspnea, chest pain, syncope, and intolerance to physical exercise. Sudden death may occur due to congestive heart failure, myocardial infarction, valvular insufficiencies or ventricular arrhythmias. The majority of cases reported are of an ALCAPA, while ARCAPA is rarely observed.
